if.test: (startDt != null and startDt != '') and (endDt != null and endDt != '')

choose.when: AND c.created_at BETWEEN DATE(#{startDt}) AND DATE_ADD(DATE(#{endDt}), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND c.updated_at BETWEEN DATE(#{startDt}) AND DATE_ADD(DATE(#{endDt}), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND c.assigned_at BETWEEN DATE(#{startDt}) AND DATE_ADD(DATE(#{endDt}), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND c.created_at BETWEEN DATE(#{startDt}) AND DATE_ADD(DATE(#{endDt}), INTERVAL 1 DAY) or c.updated_at BETWEEN DATE(#{startDt}) AND DATE_ADD(DATE(#{endDt}), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
and c.emp_no like concat('%',#{searchKeyword},'%') or ct.template_title like concat('%',#{searchKeyword},'%') or c.name like concat('%',#{searchKeyword},'%')

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(c.CONTRACT_NO) FROM CONTRACTS C JOIN CONTRACT_TEMPLATE CT ON C.TEMPLATE_SEQ = CT.TEMPLATE_SEQ JOIN USERS U ON C.EMP_NO = U.EMP_NO where C.del_yn = 'N'

select c.contract_no , ct.template_title , ctd.contract_title_en , c.name , c.emp_no , c.created_at , c.sign_date , c.qes_sign_at , c.doc_status from contracts c join contract_template ct on c.template_seq = ct.template_seq join contract_template_details ctd on ct.template_seq = ctd.template_seq where 1=1 and c.doc_status in ('PRCS1004' , 'PRCS1005') and c.process_status = 'PRCS2003' and c.qes_yn ='Y'
order by c.created_at LIMIT #{paging.displayRow} OFFSET #{paging.offset}

SELECT c.contract_no , c.emp_no , c.template_seq , c.doc_status , c.process_status , c.signature_data_no , c.validation , c.agree_yn , c.del_yn , c.created_by , c.created_at , c.updated_by , c.updated_at , ct.template_title , c.name , c.sign_date , ctd.contract_title_en , c.dept_code , c.assigned_at , c.qes_sign_at from contracts c join contract_template ct on c.template_seq = ct.template_seq join contract_template_details ctd on ct.template_seq = ctd.template_seq where c.contract_no = #{seq}
